content: Werewolf novel  Based on Ferdinand III and his sword  Lobera  ,  This is a generational novel. Basically the main character is of the royal bloodline based in this day and age in America.  However  he is the last descendant and he is approached by a secret Franciscan sect, this sect wants him to take possession of the sword to kill Werewolves,  Not all werewolves are bad he will come to find out just like not all the members of the  franscican  sect are good.
